verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt describing the Fellow API. The developer reference pages are also published as raw .md URLs (authentication, webhooks, pagination, Fellow Markdown), which an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the llms.txt index is, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
